description:
When you think of construction you typical think of a high school drop out, alcoholic, wife abuser.  I know that sounds really dark but true.  Construction has been considered a dead end job that people settle for, not pursue.

What if that wasn't the case?

What if the face of construction could be passionate, caring, invested men and women that were working hard to make their cities, families and friends lives brighter... better.

Empowered Electric was started to answer the question, "What if we cared More about People and Less about Profit?" 

The Answer: A Group of Passionate men and women are working hard to make their cities, families and friends lives brighter... better.
